title: Shorter Lean version of Anthropic&\#x27;s GRH verification discussed
summary: A GitHub repository by lsernau publishes a much shorter Lean formalization of Anthropic&\#x27;s GRH verification, which Hacker News commenters describe as far more readable and heavily documented. Commenters report the proof shrinking from roughly 17 million lines to about 76 thousand, a 99.56% reduction, though another commenter refers to a 300k-line proof, so the precise figures are not verified by the item itself. Commenters also note the rewrite separates "known math" from "new math" and includes human-readable documentation throughout. The item supplies no source content, so the artifact&\#x27;s correctness, completeness, and fidelity to the original formalization remain unestablished here.
